target.statement: TPD COPOD achieves F1-score of 0.930 on the SWaT dataset

compute.basis: The method is simple (ECOD + two COPOD models) and runs in seconds on CPU, but SWaT data requires a request form and approval, and no code is provided, so implementation and data acquisition add significant time.

blockers: SWaT dataset requires a signed request form and approval from iTrust, not freely downloadable
No code or implementation details (e.g., exact preprocessing, window size) are provided
title: Two-phase Dual COPOD Method for Anomaly Detection in Industrial Control System
